封景心和祁煜洺更是从座位上跳了起来。
也不知封庭漪是不是关注点全在林芜身上，他倒没有发现封庭深他们也在。
封庭漪很惊喜：“嫂子，你也被我女神迷住了对吗？！我就说不管男女，就没有谁会不喜欢我女神！”
她现在想拿出手机给封庭深打个电话。
想知道此时此刻，封庭深接到她电话会有什么反应——很大可能是，看到她的来电后就直接挂掉。
毕竟，封庭深一直都是这么对她的。
想到这，她就觉得这个电话已经没打的必要了。
想到这，容辞还是拿起了手机，给封庭深打了个电话过去，然后拿起了望远镜。
然后，她亲眼看到封庭深看到是她的来电后，毫不犹豫就挂了，之后封庭深就将视线重新放回了林芜身上。
容辞深吸了一口气，然后笑了笑，平静地把望远镜还给了封庭漪。
之后的比赛，容辞都没有再看，也没有再关注封庭深那边。
封庭漪超级激动，他和他朋友都非常想去找她要签名。
“可听说cc既是豪门千金，又是名校毕业的博士生，玩赛车只是她的兴趣爱好，她不需要粉丝，更不媚粉，基本上每次都是比完赛就直接走人，从来没给粉丝签过名，所以，想要她的签名，基本上是不可能的事。”
“是啊，这次是私人比赛，本来拿到签名照的可能性是比较大的，可场地内有赛车手专属通道，我们没有关系也进不去里面，哎……”
封庭漪和他的朋友正讨论着，就听说林芜已经和她的朋友一起离开，去庆祝了。
桑倩已经打电话来催了，容辞驳回了封庭漪想和朋友一起去嗨的请求，准备把人带回去。

从洗手间出来时，和一人撞了个正着。
容辞和对方均后退一步，并同一时间道歉。
看到她，他本来就冷淡的神色，就更冷淡了几分。
封庭深和贺长柏他们，却是从小一起长大的发小，关系极好。
他们小时候一起上学一起玩；长大了一起合作项目，隔一段时间就会聚一聚。
不管是小时候还是婚后，封庭深一直把她排除在他的圈子以外。
所以，她和贺长柏，祁煜洺他们虽然也认识了十多年，却连点头之交都算不上。

And Rong Ci also noticed that even though he was as calm and cold as Feng Tingshen, he still clearly showed an expression of surprise and admiration at this moment.
Feng Jingxin and Qi Yuming jumped up from their seats.
I don't know if Feng Tingyi's focus was entirely on Lin Wu, but he didn't realize that Feng Tingshen and the others were there.
Feng Tingyi was very surprised: "Sister-in-law, you are also fascinated by my goddess, right?! I said that no matter whether you are a man or a woman, there is no one who doesn't like my goddess!"
She now wanted to take out her mobile phone and call Feng Tingshen.
I wonder how Feng Tingshen would react when he received her call at this moment - most likely, he would hang up immediately after seeing her call.
After all, Feng Tingshen had always treated her like this.
Thinking of this, she felt that the call was no longer necessary.
Thinking of this, Rong Ci picked up the phone, called Feng Tingshen, and then picked up the telescope.
Then, she saw with her own eyes that Feng Tingshen hung up without hesitation after seeing that it was her call. After that, Feng Tingshen returned his attention to Lin Wu.
Rong Ci took a deep breath, then smiled and calmly returned the telescope to Feng Tingyi.
Rong Ci didn't watch the subsequent games, nor did he pay attention to Feng Tingshen.
Feng Tingyi was super excited. He and his friends really wanted to go to her and get her autograph.
"But I heard that cc is both a rich and powerful daughter and a doctoral student who graduated from a prestigious school. Racing is just her hobby. She doesn't need fans, and she doesn't want fans. Basically, she just leaves after every game. She has never signed autographs for fans. Therefore, it is basically impossible to get her autograph."
"Yes, this is a private race, and the possibility of getting an autographed photo is relatively high, but there is an exclusive channel for racers in the venue, and we can't get in without being connected, hey..."
Feng Tingyi and his friends were discussing when they heard that Lin Wu had left with her friends to celebrate.
Sang Qian had already called to urge her, but Rong Ci rejected Feng Tingyi's request to go have fun with her friends and prepared to take him back.
When I came out of the bathroom, I bumped into someone.
Rong Ci and the other party both took a step back and apologized at the same time.
Seeing her, his already cold expression became even colder.
Feng Tingshen and He Changbai grew up together and have a very good relationship.
When they were young, they went to school and played together; when they grew up, they collaborated on projects together, and would get together every once in a while.
Whether it was as a child or after marriage, Feng Tingshen had always excluded her from his circle.
Therefore, although she, He Changbai and Qi Yuming had known each other for more than ten years, they were not even acquaintances.
